info.title: Huerise Alarm API
info.description: API for managing sunrise alarms with Philips Hue. Every endpoint requires an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.

post.description: Start playback and return immediately -- the sound keeps playing.
Preview a scene the way an alarm would start it.

put.description: Switch the output. Anything currently playing is stopped first.

get.summary: Subscribe to the alarm event stream
get.description:
Server-sent events covering every change to alarms and to the run currently in
progress, so a display can stay in sync without polling.

Each frame carries the event id in `id:`, the discriminator in `event:` and the
event itself as JSON in `data:`. Reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` to resume; if
that id has rolled out of the buffer nothing is replayed, so resync over
`GET /alarms` first. A `: keepalive` comment arrives whenever the stream is
idle.

AlarmField.title: AlarmField
AlarmField.description: A field of an alarm rule that a change can be reported against.

AlarmSnapshot.title: AlarmSnapshot
AlarmSnapshot.description:
An alarm rule as of the moment an event fired.

Carries enough to render a row without a follow-up GET, so a display can
stay in sync from the stream alone.

AlarmUpdate.title: AlarmUpdate
AlarmUpdate.description: A partial change. Omitted fields keep their current value.

changed.title: Changed
changed.description: The fields this update actually moved.

AudioOutput.title: AudioOutput
AudioOutput.description: Where alarm and preview audio is played.

AudioOutputRead.title: AudioOutputRead
AudioOutputRead.description: The device sounds are currently played on.

output.description: The output to play on from now on.

sound_id.title: Sound Id
sound_id.description: UUID of a sound returned by GET /sounds, e.g. '5c0806e7-7162-5be7-948e-33d349bde4a8'.

alarm.description: None when no enabled alarm remains.

NextAlarmChanged.title: NextAlarmChanged
NextAlarmChanged.description:
The alarm that will fire next is now a different one, or fires at a
different time. Derived -- never emitted by hand.

OccurrenceProgress.title: OccurrenceProgress
OccurrenceProgress.description:
One sunrise step. Fires per brightness change, so it carries no snapshot:
the occurrence itself does not move while the sunrise runs.

OccurrenceSnapshot.title: OccurrenceSnapshot
OccurrenceSnapshot.description: One concrete run of an alarm as of the moment an event fired.

OccurrenceStarted.title: OccurrenceStarted
OccurrenceStarted.description: The sunrise has begun. Everything a display needs to open its wake screen.

ProfileRead.title: ProfileRead
ProfileRead.description: Everything a profile is created with, plus what the server owns.

sound_id.title: Sound Id
sound_id.description: UUID of a sound returned by GET /sounds, e.g. '5c0806e7-7162-5be7-948e-33d349bde4a8'.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA zone. The alarm keeps its wall-clock time across DST.

days.title: Days
days.description: Empty means the alarm fires once, then disables itself.

ScheduleSchema.title: ScheduleSchema
ScheduleSchema.description: When an alarm fires, as wall-clock time in a named zone.

id.title: Id
id.description: Store this UUID in a profile.

SoundRead.title: SoundRead
SoundRead.description: A sound as an alarm profile refers to it.

scene_name.title: Scene Name
scene_name.description: Name of a Hue scene from GET /rooms/{room_name}.

AccessToken.description: Send the API access token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
